js: H.flight.start('docked', 0.35); H.flight.transit(); H.flight.simulate(2.6, ['KeyW']); const g = H.flight.game; const f = g.frame; const wx = f.origin.x + g.player.x * f.tx + g.player.z * f.rx; const wy = f.origin.y + g.player.x * f.ty + g.player.z * f.ry; console.error('IN ' + Math.hypot(wx, wy).toFixed(0))

const L = H.ring.layout; const th = 90 * h.DEG; const v = h.v3; const fr = h.frameAt(th); const pos = fr.out.clone().multiplyScalar(L.radii.floorMid + 7000).add(fr.along.clone().multiplyScalar(-3500)).add(v(0,0,2400)); const tgt = fr.out.clone().multiplyScalar(L.radii.floorMid); H.setCine({ pos, fwd: tgt.sub(pos).normalize(), up: v(0,0,1), fov: 50, sun: { azimuth: th / h.DEG - 30, elevation: 35 } })
